name: Publuu Flipbook
author: Publuu

sections.description:
Publuu is a digital flipbook maker that transforms static PDFs into realistic, interactive flipbooks that are easy to share and track online. Turn brochures, catalogs, and magazines into engaging digital publications that look and feel like real books – fully responsive and optimized for all devices.
With Publuu, you can customize your flipbook to match your brand, add interactive elements and share your publication anywhere online. Trusted by businesses worldwide, Publuu helps companies present content in a more engaging, professional, and measurable way.
The Publuu WordPress plugin makes embedding flipbooks into your website fast and effortless. Simply upload a PDF to your Publuu account, generate your flipbook, and embed it into any page or post in seconds – no coding required.
Discover our flipbook examples and see what you can create with this interactive format.

Features:

  • Branding: Customize your flipbook with your logo, brand colors, background, and custom domain to create a fully branded reading experience. Adjust the viewer interface and design so your publication perfectly matches your website and company identity.

  • Interactive elements: Enhance your PDF with videos, audio files, image galleries, links, and buttons to increase engagement. Transform static documents into immersive digital experiences that keep readers interacting longer.

  • Sharing options: Share your flipbook with a direct link, QR code, or across social media platforms in just a few clicks. You can also send it via email or publish it privately with restricted access.

  • Website embedding: Embed your flipbook seamlessly into any page or post so it becomes a natural part of your website. The viewer is fully responsive and works on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

  • Document protection: Protect your content with password protection, domain restrictions, and access controls. Disable download, printing, or sharing options to maintain full control over your documents.

  • Reader analytics: Track how readers interact with your flipbooks in real time. Monitor views, reading time, clicks, and engagement metrics to better understand your audience and optimize your content strategy.

  • Instant email notifications: Receive real-time email notifications when someone opens or interacts with your flipbook. Stay informed about audience activity and respond to leads at the perfect moment.

  • Lead generation form: Add customizable lead capture forms directly inside your flipbook to collect emails and contact details. Turn your digital publications into powerful marketing tools that generate new business opportunities.

  • Product tags: Add product tags and clickable shopping buttons directly to your flipbook pages. Allow readers to explore products and purchase instantly, making your catalogs and brochures fully interactive.
sections.installation:
1. Go to your WP Dashboard > Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for ‘Publuu Flipbook’.
  3. Click ‘Install Now’ and then ‘Activate’.
  4. Go to the ‘Publuu’ menu in your sidebar.
  5. Connect your account (or register if you haven’t already).
  6. Upload a PDF to create your first flipbook.
  7. Use the ‘Publuu’ block in any post or page to display it.
sections.faq:
Do I need an account to use this plugin?

Yes, you need to connect the plugin to a Publuu account. The plugin handles the connection securely to manage your flipbooks.

How to create a flipbook?

To create a flipbook, prepare a PDF file with your content, then create a free account at Publuu and upload your file. Our Online Flipbook Maker will automatically convert it into an interactive HTML5 flipbook that you can easily customize with your branding, embed into your WordPress website, share anywhere online, and track its real-time performance.

Is it mobile friendly?

Yes, the flipbooks created with Publuu are fully responsive and touch-optimized for mobile devices.

Where are my files stored?

Your original PDF is uploaded to your WordPress Media Library, and the converted flipbook version is hosted securely on Publuu’s cloud servers to ensure high performance and fast loading speeds for your visitors.
